title: P1c smoke: tool-first discovery
kind: P1c single-variable tool-first workflow; discovery only
hypothesis: P1/P1b failed because the model could skip tools and self-report checks. A tool-only first stage, executed by code, should guarantee real reads; the hypothesis stage can then use those reads. If stage 1 returns no tool call, the window fails without a hypothesis/candidate call.
selection_reason: tornado-3 (no candidate in P1) and youtube-dl-4 (the one P1 baseline hit); both sides, one r0 window per side, four windows per arm.
metrics: first-stage real tool calls and executed results
reference candidate recall on the two cases
adoption: At least one real tool call on both buggy windows and no loss of the baseline reference hit, with no fixed-side alarm; otherwise reject. A four-window smoke is exploratory and cannot be generalized.
scope: Discovery only; no evidence engine, official tests/labels/opposite version in the Agent input. One repetition; all requests, failures and no-tool windows retained.
